HOME IMPROVEMENT CONTRACT

This Home Improvement Contract is between Redwood Remodeling, Inc. ("Contractor"), license number 884213, and Pat Morales ("Owner").

1. Work. Contractor will remodel the kitchen at 22 Laurel Way as described in the attached plans.

2. Price. The contract price is $48,500. Owner will pay a down payment of $1,000 on signing and the balance in four progress payments.

3. Schedule. Work will start on about May 4, 2026 and will be substantially complete by about July 31, 2026.

4. Changes. Extra work must be approved in a written change order before it is done.
